title: Changing the Installment of a Current Plan — Benefit Overpayment Accounts Console Reference
content:
A claimant whose overpayment among Benefit Overpayment Accounts carries a current repayment plan may have its monthly installment changed. The changed plan carries exactly the changed monthly installment worked out for it, keeping its first installment due date and the classification's due day.

## Condition on a change

A plan's monthly installment is changed only after every waiver request lodged on the overpayment carries a decision.

The status of each waiver request on the overpayment is what decides it: while any of them still reads received, awaiting a decision, the installment is not changed.

## What the change records

The change replaces the plan's monthly installment on the overpayment record with the changed installment. The plan status, the due date of the plan's opening installment and the monthly due day stay as they were.

## The change tool

The change is made with `change_repayment_plan_f1933d01`, a tool that belongs to the claimant, by which the claimant agrees to a new monthly installment on a plan already in force. The representative unlocks it with `unlock_user_discoverable_tool` and hands it over; the customer themselves runs it with `call_user_discoverable_tool`.

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `overpayment_id` | The reference number of the benefit overpayment whose plan is changed, as given to the claimant by the representative from the overpayment record | Reference number |
| `monthly_amount` | The new monthly installment, as the representative states it | USD, 2 decimal places (0.00 when no plan); an amount with more decimals is rounded to the nearest cent when recorded |

**Return.** On success the receipt shows `overpayment_id`, `repayment_plan_status` (the plan status, unchanged), `repayment_plan_monthly_amount` (the installment recorded, USD to 2 decimal places) and `repayment_plan_start_date` (the due date of the plan's opening installment, YYYY-MM-DD, unchanged). A receipt showing the new installment means the change is recorded. If the overpayment reference number matches no overpayment, the reply starts with "Error:" and nothing changes.

*Illustration (hypothetical values):* changing overpayment OP-6602 to 41.25 returns `repayment_plan_monthly_amount` 41.25 with the plan status and opening due date as they were.
